summary: Password field with a four-segment pixel strength meter, a show/hide toggle and a rule checklist; minScore blocks weak passwords.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial password when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field, linked to the input.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the password submits under it.

props.name: minScore
props.description: Lowest acceptable strength from 0 to 4 (Too weak, Weak, Fair, Good, Strong). A weaker password makes the input invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the field and disables the input and the show/hide button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the new password.

props.name: onScoreChange
props.description: Called when an edit changes the strength score, with the new score from 0 to 4.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called when the input commits a change (on blur after editing), with the password and its score.

accessibility: A native `<input type="password">` with `autocomplete="new-password"`, labelled by a `<label htmlFor>`.
The show/hide button is a toggle: its `aria-label` stays "Show password", `aria-pressed` carries the state and `aria-controls` points at the input.

The meter canvas has `role="meter"`, `aria-label="Password strength"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="4"`, `aria-valuenow` and an `aria-valuetext` with the strength word ("No password" while empty).
The strength word is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
The rule checklist describes the input (`aria-describedby`). Each rule ends in visually hidden text, "met" or "not met", since its bullet shows the state by colour only.
motion: With reduced motion the meter jumps to the new score, checklist bullets do not pop and the strength word swaps without rolling.
form: A native `<input>` submits the password under `name`. When the score is below `minScore` it sets a custom validity message naming the required level, for example "Choose a stronger password (Good or better)", which blocks submission. Form reset restores `defaultValue`, hides the password again and calls `onValueChange` when that changes the value.
notes: Scoring: one point each for 8 or more characters, upper and lower case, a number and a symbol. 12 or more characters with at least three of those score 4.
Strength words and rules are in English.
`className` and other `div` props go to the wrapper.
